frontmatter.name: solid-principles
frontmatter.description: Guides the systematic auditing, refactoring, and implementation of SOLID architectural design principles (Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion) tailored for modern TypeScript, React 19, Next.js 16, and full-stack software architectures. Use when evaluating code craftsmanship, decoupling monolithic components, designing extensible registry patterns, or isolating interfaces.
